description: This file is a PHP source file that defines a Smarty plugin, specifically a modifier plugin named 'debug_print_var'. It contains a function that formats various PHP variable types into a string suitable for debugging display, including handling recursive data structures, objects, arrays, and scalar types.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_debug_print_var
methods.description: Formats a variable into an HTML-safe string for debugging, with options for controlling recursion depth, string length, and handling of objects and arrays.
